root.label: Energy Innovation modeling of Trump energy policies and household costs

events.label: Energy Innovation modeling of Trump energy policies and household costs

slots.name: job-loss states
slots.sentence: These changes will result in annual household energy costs rising in every state in the contiguous U.S., plus job losses in 47 of 48 states and losses to the gross domestic product in 46 states, Energy Innovation said.

slots.name: premature deaths
slots.sentence: It’s projecting 37,000 additional premature deaths from air pollution, $72 billion in additional healthcare costs and more than 9 billion tons of additional carbon pollution because of the environmental rollbacks.

slots.name: electric bill increase
slots.sentence: Climate Justice Alliance legislative director Mar Zepeda said her Washington, D.C., electric bill increased $200 in the past month.

slots.name: report date
slots.sentence: A 2025 Department of Energy report, mandated by Trump, warned of increasing blackouts if the U.S. continued closing coal and natural gas plants.
